visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy with messy dark hair and a distressed facial expression is crying intensely while wrapped in a white, textured towel. He stands in an indoor hallway featuring light beige walls and a dark wooden door frame. A small tabby cat is briefly visible in the background near a window. (2) The scene shifts to a close-up of the boy's head as a white handheld hair dryer is used to blow air through his damp hair. His eyes are squeezed shut, and tears are streaming down his cheeks. He continues to sob with his mouth wide open. (3) The boy is now wearing a white long-sleeved shirt decorated with colorful Disney-themed patterns. He is laughing and playfully blowing a large snot bubble from his nose while an adult's tattooed arm (featuring a dog) is visible in the frame. (4) The boy sits on a light-colored wooden floor downstairs, clutching a small plush Corgi toy. He is crying again, looking upward with a mournful expression. A cat walks across the floor in the background. (5) An adult hand extends a large, bright red strawberry towards the boy's face. He accepts it but remains visually somber, looking away from the camera. (6) The boy interacts with a tabby cat on the floor, leaning his head against its fur for comfort. Later, he is seen standing on a staircase holding the Corgi plushie and looking out a window at the rain. (7) A vibrant outdoor scene shows a real Corgi dog running through lush green grass in a sunny park with soft lighting. The video concludes with a black screen and white Chinese text.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 上點空間建築. [Subtitle]: 在昨晚我幫兒子洗完澡後. (2) [Subtitle]: 他突然間哭了出來. (3) [Subtitle]: 你在想酒酒對不對?. (4) [Subtitle]: (對). (5) [Subtitle]: 他突然想酒酒想到在哭. (6) [Subtitle]: 沒事，沒事. (7) [Subtitle]: 酒酒在宇宙大神旁邊. (8) [Subtitle]: (哭到戽斗). (9) [Subtitle]: 因為洗完澡他太想酒酒突然間哭成這樣. (10) [Subtitle]: 我也不知道他到底在想什麼. (11) [Subtitle]: 畢竟酒酒離開已經超過半年以上了. (12) [Subtitle]: 頭髮吹乾在穿衣服的時候. (13) [Subtitle]: 他的情緒有好一點. (14) [Subtitle]: 看他還有心情在那邊玩鼻涕. (15) [Subtitle]: 我以為事情就這樣結束了. (16) [Subtitle]: 誰知道下樓以後他的情緒完全爆炸. (17) [Subtitle]: 手裡拿著前幾天逛街的時候幫他買的柯基娃娃. (18) [Subtitle]: 他說他很可愛跟酒酒長得超像. (19) [Subtitle]: 所以就幫他買了. (20) [Subtitle]: 連拿出他最愛吃的日本草莓. (21) [Subtitle]: 也阻止不了他的思念. (22) [Subtitle]: 但是就算再怎麼悲傷生活還是要過. (23) [Subtitle]: 就算是他自己養的恐龍（電子恐龍蛋）. (24) [Subtitle]: 大的大便自己還是要去清理. (25) [Subtitle]: 在這個過程中他最好的好兄弟小玉米. (26) [Subtitle]: 一直陪在他的旁邊陪他一起哭. (27) [Subtitle]: 中間有一段我覺得很可愛. (28) [Subtitle]: 他自己拿著柯基娃娃跑到樓梯間. (29) [Subtitle]: 對著正在下雨的窗外. (30) [Subtitle]: 偷偷地對酒酒說出他對他思念的話. (31) [Subtitle]: 有時候想想失去之所以會讓人難過. (32) [Subtitle]: 是因為它有讓你難以忘懷的記憶與情感. (33) [Subtitle]: 但人生還在繼續. (34) [Subtitle]: 失去雖然令人悲傷. (35) [Subtitle]: 但珍惜目前擁有的一切更是重要. (36) [Subtitle]: 熊孩子已經很久沒哭了. (37) [Subtitle]: 所以我就給他一個空間讓他慢慢地哭慢慢地沉澱. (38) [Subtitle]: 最後哭累的他決定好好安慰一下自己. (39) [Subtitle]: 想你，酒酒.

The narrator continues his steady delivery, describing the scene. (3) The child's vocal state shifts abruptly into high-pitched laughter and bubbling sounds, indicating a brief moment of amusement. The music remains consistent in its sad tonality, creating a poignant contrast with the child's giggle. (4) The child returns to rhythmic sobbing with a nasal, congested quality. The sound of soft footsteps on a wooden floor and the rustle of clothing are heard as the narrator reflects on the boy's grief. (5) A rattling sound of a plastic container or jar occurs as the child speaks a few quiet words. The BGM piano chords swell slightly, adding emotional weight to the narrative conclusion. (6) The final audio phase features the piano music fading out with a clean decay, followed by a moment of quiet room tone before the track ends.
